summary: Tested onboarding->dashboard first-session/returning-session behavior on backend and UI. New-user flow works (Welcome to ClearPath + first-visit panel + mark-visited transition), but existing seeded users currently fail returning-user expectation and are treated as first-session users.

critical.issue: Existing seeded users (admin.clearpath@example.com, student.clearpath@example.com) return is_first_session=true and welcome_message=Welcome to ClearPath instead of Welcome back because has_visited_dashboard/has_completed_first_login are false.
Re-submitting onboarding resets has_completed_first_login=false, has_visited_dashboard=false, dashboard_visit_count=0, causing regression from returning-user state back to first-session state.

integration_issues.issue: UI mirrors backend regression and shows first-session onboarding panel for seeded existing student account instead of returning-user experience.

action_items: Fix seeded/returning-user state so existing users satisfy returning criteria (has_completed_onboarding=true AND has_visited_dashboard=true/dashboard_visit_count>0) and display Welcome back.
Make /api/onboarding idempotent for returning users: do not reset has_visited_dashboard/has_completed_first_login/dashboard_visit_count after a user already completed first dashboard visit.
Add/adjust seed migration logic to set correct dashboard visit flags for known existing users if they should be treated as returning users.
critical_code_review_comments: Onboarding endpoint currently force-resets dashboard visit flags on every submission; this couples profile updates with session-state mutation and creates greeting regressions.
server.py is oversized (>700 lines), increasing regression risk for cross-feature state logic (auth/onboarding/dashboard flags).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (new-user first-session flow passes; existing-user returning greeting fails due backend state)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple new test users via /api/auth/register for first-session and transition validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified with pytest + Playwright: new registration -> onboarding -> dashboard shows Welcome to ClearPath and all first-visit widgets (roadmap summary, recommended first course, assigned AI Professor, next steps), then revisit flips to Welcome back after mark-visited call. Seeded student/admin currently show first-session state. Reproduced RCA: re-posting onboarding after mark-visited flips user back to first-session state.
rca of the issue: RCA: State reset bug in onboarding transition logic. Repro: register user -> onboarding -> mark-visited -> /dashboard shows returning state (expected) -> post /onboarding again -> /dashboard reverts to is_first_session=true and Welcome to ClearPath. Root cause is unconditional reset in /api/onboarding update: has_completed_first_login=False, has_visited_dashboard=False, dashboard_visit_count=0. This also explains seeded existing accounts currently being treated as first-session when their flags are false.
